RUNTIME FACT LIST vs public text. Entry/start: instruction.md:13 'It must start with node /app/server.js'; integration.md:5 'starts from /app/server.js' = test.sh:68,97 (/app/server.js, fallback copy). Port: instruction.md:13 'listen on port 3000 (honour PORT if it's set)'; integration.md:5 = test.sh:48,108 PORT=3000; all prompts and app_context.md:4 use http://localhost:3000. Storage: instruction.md:13 'keep its durable data in /app/app.db, honouring DB_PATH when that is set'; integration.md:7-8 = test.sh:98-109 DB_PATH=/app/app.db or /tmp/submission/app.db, restart helper test.sh:165. Health: instruction.md:13 'expose GET /api/health as a check that never touches the database' = test.sh:48 probe. Launch env/user/cwd: hireops_rules.md:198-202 names unprivileged user, writable copy, non-/app cwd and env PATH, HOME, NODE_PATH, PORT, DB_PATH = test.sh:104-111 env -i set exactly. Symlinks: integration.md:16-19 = test.sh:72-83. Deps: instruction.md:13 'Server dependencies are already available, so don't install packages'; integration.md:3-4 Express/better-sqlite3 via NODE_PATH. Seed: instruction.md:13,15 '/assets/seed_data.json', copy into /app, load once, no shipped DB, keep across restarts; hireops_rules.md:204-209 explains read markers (read_count counted from first message), candidate wording and page size 30 in the file. Accounts: instruction.md:17 lists all 10 emails with roles and password Hireops!2026; display names come from seed users and app_context.md:8-19 (consistent). Restart: instruction.md:15 'keep new work across restarts' covers hro_restart/restart_app. Fixed clock: N-A - no criterion or prompt depends on wall-clock time (grep for clock/today/ago/date in criteria and prompts: none); only 15-second freshness windows, which are public (instruction.md:5, hireops_rules.md:117). Seed created_at values are sorted and unique per conversation, so seed order equals time order. Network is public; no offline constraint required; instruction.md:13 allows CDN for the browser side.
GRADED-WAS-ASKED walk over all 46 criteria (2 gates, 34 functional, 5 polish, 5 visual): every demand traces to public text. hro_job_open places 0/51/2.5 and non-manager refused <- rules:27-29 'whole number from 1 to 50', 'chosen from the hiring-manager accounts'; hro_add_email_rules refusal at field and typed name kept <- rules:32-35; hro_move_one_stage/hro_reject_hired/hro_reopen/hro_reject_reason (non-drag) <- rules:47-52, instruction.md:3; hro_arrive_bottom/hro_reorder <- rules:57-59; interview-capacity rows <- rules:63-65,98; hro_refused_put_back focus <- rules:84-85; hro_mgr_* <- rules:15-17,69-73; hro_observer_readonly/hro_candidate_no_staff <- rules:18-19,73,194; hro_anonymous exact 401 <- rules:21; hro_stale_refused names who plus 15s catch-up <- rules:77-80, instruction.md:3,5; bulk rows board order/all-or-none/places <- rules:89-92; undo rows (undo of reopening restores reason, re-order/reject by others blocks, a note does not, once only, earlier move lost after a later one) <- rules:96-100; hro_activity/refusals <- rules:110-113; hro_notes <- rules:104-106; live/unread/seen/thread rows <- rules:117-166 (30-page, remaining count, scrolled-up notice, Observer never counts, job's hiring manager makes candidate message seen); hro_drafts and hro_pol_session_resume (per-person per-browser reply and note drafts, re-sign-in prompt at next server action) <- instruction.md:7, rules:105-106,170-175; hro_pol_failed_send <- rules:139-140; hro_pol_earlier_place <- rules:146-147; hro_pol_live_board/thread <- rules:121-123,158; hro_candidate_view/private/linked wording table and not-found <- rules:22-23,34-36,179-194; visual rows <- instruction.md:11 'clear desktop workspace'; no phone layout or theme demanded. Seed-derived literals verified in seed_data.json: Lena (USR-CAN3) read_count 2 of 3 on APP-301, third message by USR-REC3 -> 1 unread (functional prompt Z); Platform Engineer Applied Greta Lindqvist, Ade Bello, Marco Rossi / Screen Priya Nair, Samuel Ortiz by position; Noor note 'Strong systems answers; weaker on incident follow-up.'; APP-101 has 120 messages (app_context.md:30).
ADVERSARIAL: (a) Conforming alternatives that could fail - app resolving files from cwd, ignoring PORT or DB_PATH, answering anonymous API calls with 302 instead of 401, ordering seeded cards by id instead of position: each is excluded by explicit public text (rules:198-202, instruction.md:13, rules:21, rules:206), so a failure is the app's fault, not a hidden requirement. Role/candidate refusals are graded as 'refused' (no specific code) except where public text fixes it (401 anonymous; not-found for candidates), so a staff 403-vs-404 choice is not over-graded. Route/selector/label freedom is public (rules:3-5, instruction.md:11,13) and prompts forbid assuming routes (functional prompt:15,17). (b) A broken app that could pass this row: not applicable to a static instruction-vs-criteria row; dead/static apps are owned by gate rows.
NON-BLOCKING NOTES: (1) Blank job title refusal (hro_job_open) is implied by rules:27 'A job has a title' rather than stated as a refusal; one reasonable reading, not a hidden requirement. (2) Hiring manager refusal to add candidates (hro_mgr_early_refused) relies on the role table rules:14-19 plus the 403 rule rules:21-22 rather than an explicit 'only a recruiter adds' sentence (rules:28 makes 'only' explicit for jobs); adequate. (3) instruction.md:15 says /assets is unavailable at runtime while test.sh:88 leaves it readable; safe direction. No runtime measurement is required for this static row; scripted golden evidence in raw-evidence-index.json was not used as proof. This Pass is not evidence of an Oracle, model or portal score.
